thread.title: Apple target price boosted at Instinet due to 'robust' iPhone shipment times

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple target price boosted at Instinet due to 'robust' iPhone shipment times
text: Instinet analyst Jeffrey Kvaal upped his price target on shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.38% to $215 from $210 on Friday, writing of "stabilizing" shipment times for the iPhone XS and XS Max. That "lifts visibility into the trajectory of two of the three new phones," he said. Shipment times for the iPhone XS Max look "more robust than anticipated," according to Kvaal, who said that Chinese consumers can get the phone within about a week while U.S. shoppers can get one after about two weeks. Shipment times for the iPhone XS are down to about five days. "We interpret this as a mix shift towards the Max, not higher demand," Kvaal wrote. He kept his neutral rating on the stock, which is down 0.1% in premarket trading. The shares have gained 47% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.14% has gained 18%.
